words.name: Fate and Spoils
words.blurb: Spoils cards for land you take, and a Fate mission with a reward.
words.opening: You hold two Spoils cards, a Sword and a Tower, and a Fate mission: take 3 territories, 1 taken so far. Both reward you for taking land.
words.goal: Finish the mission by taking 2 more territories, and hold three Spoils cards, by turn 4.
words.met: The mission is done and you hold three Spoils cards
hints: Any turn you take land, you earn one Spoils card. Your mission is on your Leader card: tap it to light up its target.
Three cards make a set: three alike, or one of each (the best). Tap your card stack, then a set, to turn it in.
From turn 4's planning, everyone draws a Fate card each turn: mostly an event somewhere on the map, sometimes a mission.
words.closing: Missions and Spoils both pay you for taking land, so a good attack can pay twice.
